offering_description.value: Sells over-the-counter medicines and personal healthcare products to retailers and wholesalers for consumer use. It manages a portfolio of brands, manufactures some products in-house and sources others from contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: digestive and motion sickness remedies; feminine health products; eye drops; oral care products; topical and pain relief remedies

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmacy chains, mass merchants, grocers, online retailers and wholesalers; B2C: Consumers buying nonprescription treatments and personal care products for home use

end_markets.value: over-the-counter healthcare; personal care; eye care; oral care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Packaged nonprescription medicines and personal healthcare products sold to retailers and wholesalers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Sources finished healthcare products from contract manufacturers and markets them to retailers and wholesalers; OEM / manufacturer: Turns ingredients and packaging into selected finished healthcare products for retailers and wholesalers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States and Canada, with operations in Australia and New Zealand and sales in other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Digestive, feminine, eye and oral care alongside pain relief, cough and throat remedies, and skin treatments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales to major pharmacy, mass merchandise and grocery accounts; third-party retail: Pharmacies, supermarkets, mass merchants and club stores; online: Online marketplaces and retailer websites; distributors / dealers: Wholesalers and distributors supplying domestic and international retailers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; third-party retail; online; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA oversight of OTC drugs and applicable devices, including marketing requirements, labeling and manufacturing standards
